The speaker describes a referral benefit tied to another person's use of a staking link.
evidence.quote: referral program eight percent of the B&B used to hire validators by anyone who starts Staking using your link.

evidence.observation: The referral section describes a direct, one-level referral system and displays a Copy RefLink button.
